cohort: 43 women with a previous cesarean section and 188 nulliparous women
finding: Women with a scarred uterus were less likely to reach 3 cm of cervix dilation after Dinoprostone Vaginal Insert, but once 3 cm of dilation was achieved, they were less likely to require cesarean section.
mod_finding: After Dinoprostone Vaginal Insert, women with a scarred uterus were less likely to reach 3 cm of cervix dilation but once 3 cm of dilation was achieved, they were less likely to require cesarean section.
